strategy: One shared clean plate, selective old-neutral-metal removal, RGB exposure fits to existing v4 pixels; no per-frame image generation or human deformation.

towerRestoration.method: Nearest unoccluded previous/next v4 pixel, RGB offset from mutually visible samples; fixed brace reuses canonical RGB with full old-fringe removal. No pixel outside effective matte changes.
